Mrs. Fisher: You’re back.
You: Yeah. 
You: I think I was speaking with someone just now, but I don’t remember anything… 
Mrs. Fisher: That’s actually a good thing. 
You: What do you mean? 
Mrs. Fisher: I called a few people who have a little more experience with this fish joint so that I could learn more about your case. 
Mrs. Fisher: They told me that after you finish your journey, you will get back your memories,
You: Really? 
Mrs. Fisher: Yes. The fact that you are starting to remember a little shows that you are getting closer.
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Grin+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: But there’s also bad news. Since your compatibility is rather crappy, you can’t go too deep, or you might lose yourself there.
You: Don’t worry, as soon as I finish this thing and get better at fishing, I won’t ever smoke that disgusting thing again.
#mrsfisher.Face.Normal
Mrs. Fisher: Good. Better safe than sorry.
Mrs. Fisher: After all, if you get hurt, all of this would be for nothing.
You: Hurt? Is this dangerous after all? 
Mrs. Fisher: As long as you listen to my guidance, you are completely safe. 
You: Sure…
All of a sudden this got even sketchier than before…
It’s not like I will get addicted to that thing, right? It’s so disgusting I want to vomit…
